hypothesis: The optional analytic source-onset WKB phase, t-(travel+t0), can load the exact r20 state and train end-to-end on the unchanged r23 source-support panels with target/synthesis consistency, finite gate gradients, bounded memory and reproducible artifacts.
expected_mechanism: The Fourier shift theorem moves source onset from a record-specific learned coefficient phase into the fixed retarded-time basis. This should especially help layered calibration/confirmation sources whose t0 differs from the anchor by 0.085-0.122 s despite small spatial displacement.

single_conceptual_variable.name: wkb_source_onset_phase
single_conceptual_variable.held_constant: r20 update-2600 state, r23 panels, 96 bins, frequency gate, coefficient loss, optimizer, learning rates, seed and evaluation chunks

primary_metric: two finite optimizer updates with exact checkpoint load, target/synthesis consistency, checkpoint/terminal bindings and peak CUDA below 4 GiB
failure_signal: Any state mismatch, non-finite loss, OOM, missing artifact, absent gate/source gradients, or peak allocation above 4 GiB blocks the formal onset-phase pilot.
rollback: Preserve r20-r23 artifacts. On smoke failure revert the optional flag only and do not launch formal training.
